name: osmain reference bible
statement: Built by the free-bible project from osnb, renumbered to the majority versification and extended with verses from other traditions. Inherits osnb's terms: no credit is required for this project's own work, but the source texts must be credited — the SBLGNT under CC BY 4.0 with a link to https://sblgnt.com, and the Hebrew text to https://www.tanach.us.
